name: AdaRoboVLG
description: This is the official repository for paper "Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis".

paragraphs: This is the official repository for AdaRoboVLG, an adaptive vision-language grasping framework for generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. This repository open-sources only its language-guided target grasping capability for static and dynamic scenes, supporting parallel-jaw grippers and Allegro, Inspire, and DH3 multi-finger hands. It outputs SE(3) poses and gripper widths for parallel-jaw grippers, and hand-base poses, grasp types, and joint configurations for multi-finger hands.
AdaRoboVLG is an task-adaptive vision-language grasping framework that enables robots to perform context-aware grasp synthesis under diverse task conditions and hand embodiments.
